Production Glossary · 12/50 · rights

Buyout

Definition

Buyout is a negotiated rights arrangement granting a broad specified scope of use for an agreed payment and term. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align rights decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

Related terms

  • Usage rights
  • Production hold
